reviews.comment: Very engaging prof, clearly is passionate about the subject matter and wants to see creativity out of his students.
The easiest class I had this semester. Attendance is mandatory, but he frequently lets us out early and is an easy grader.

Definity take him if you have the chance. I have taken him for 3 classes and have loved every single one, he has no exams just group assignments that are super easy and you get graded on participation. He takes attendance but if you need a personal day, are sick or just text him and it wont count against you. Will get an A if you complete the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Easy A and very caring and understanding.
Loved this professor. He is kind and I enjoyed his lectures. Does kahoot to prepare for exams. Exams are easy. Take him!

Professor Guajardo was such a nice and caring professor. His class is very interesting and the tests are open note which is very nice. I also had him for my Hullabaloo U class and enjoyed that class a lot as well. I would recommend him to any person!
GREATEST GUY EVER. Show up, do the fun projects, and boom you're getting an A+. He loves his students and loves what he does. If you need an easy yet fun class, take him!!!!!!!!!!

He is such an understanding, genuine, and kind professor. He requires attendance, but if there is a reason you can't come, he will excuse you. There were 3 group projects, 1 individual project, 3 exams, and no final. He has a review before every exam, and he gives you the questions to half of the exam. Exams are open note and he is an easy grader.

I LOVED Dr. Guajardo! He truly cared about his students and went above and beyond for us throughout the semester. He even made our class brisket sandwiches and brought them for our last class. I took 303 Data Visualization, a super easy class, and fun if you get creative with it. Heavy on the group work but not hard. Take him!
I LOVE this professor. The class was super easy and fun. He is so understanding and a great guy. TAKE THIS CLASS!
I enjoyed this professor very much! He really cares about each of his students' well-being and learning styles. He is very accommodating and wants each student to get something out of the class!

Professor Guajardo is easily one of my favorite professors at A&M. He truly is so caring and wants you to get the most you possibly can out of his course. Having it at 8 AM was a drag, but he made his lectures really enjoyable and engaging. 3 easy group projects and 3 exams (open note/book). I hope to take him more in the future, he is the best!!!!

Easy/fun class! The prof is AMAZING. We had 3 projects-making videos of our choice- vlog, DIML, etc. Some homework assignments- but he would forget to assign at times. The class could be more organized, but overall he is super sweet and makes it easy/enjoyable. I will def register for more of his classes in the future!

TAKE HIM! He is easily the best prof I have had at A&M. He really cares about his work and his students and he makes the class a ridiculously easy A. Attendance is mandatory, but he honestly made an 8 AM class really fun and exciting. Would take him 100 times over.

Professor Guajardo is one of the most fun and caring communication professors. His class was very hands on, and only project-based. Every "exam" is a video project and you can do it over literally anything that interests you. I had so much fun in his class and getting to know him. I would take it again if I could.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was the easy and fun. He made classes Friday online and the lectures were not bad at all and actually interesting. You're graded off of three projects and like three homework assignments total. Very little work required and easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take professor Guajardo if you can! This class is graded based on attendance, 3 open note quizzes, and 3 group assignments. If you show up to class and take notes from his slides, you will make an A on all 3 quizzes. He is so caring and very understanding about everything. I am looking forward to taking him for COMM 476 as well!

Prof Guajardo is the sweetest and coolest. His class is interesting and he tells funny stories. He does take an attendance quiz every class and having unexcused absenses can bump your grade down a whole letter grade, so go to class. But you hardly ever have assignments and if you do they are easy. He really cares about his students too. Easy A.

Great Professor. Honestly I believe he graded on effort and depth of speeches, and it's physically impossible to fail his class unless you didn't do a speech. You can tell he really cares about his students and the class he teaches. He is also very kind and understanding.
Great professor and even better guy! 100% would recommend

I only had this professor for one summer course, but I'd take another course if it meant he was teaching it. He is super kind, caring, and funny too. I'm so happy to say he was my first professor. The class was super straightforward, and as long as you do the work it is a guaranteed A.

I LOVED HIM! He is the kindest soul and a great prof. there are occasional group assignments, 3 exams and then one final project. they're all very straightforward and if I ever had questions he always answered them. Attendance not mandatory but with a prof as nice as him you'll feel too guilty to skip. We must protect Jonathan Guajardo at all costs
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS PROF! He is awesome! His classes are super easy and you can easily make an A in the class. There's a lot of groupwork throughout the semester but it's super easy. He is very understanding and will work with you if you're having trouble with anything. He also cancels class if the wether is bad (which is frequent). He rocks. Take this prof
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've taken at A&M. Syllabus says attendance is mandatory but just need to email him if you miss, doesn't even need to be university excused. He cares about his students and is really sweet. Try to take him if you can. Easy A.
He is a great guy with vast knowledge about filming and editing. He graded on several projects and group exercises. I will take him again and again if I can.
Great professor and great class. I would highly recommend him and any of the classes that he does.

Took the class online over the summer and received no feedback on my speeches throughout the semester. He did not post grades for the speeches where we could make improvements before the next speech. He did not respond to the groupme he set up either. By the reviews, he must be great in-person, just would not recommend taking online.
He is one of the best professors at Texas A&M. Amazing. Makes you feel comfortable even if you are scared of public speaking. Take him.
He is probably the best professor here on Campus. DO NOT hesitate to take him, absolutely the BEST!!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Two things to consider: When was the last time you saw a professor with a perfect rate my professor score, and when was the last time you took a class taught by someone students refer to as the G.O.A.T. of teaching upper level comm classes at a public institution? This should be an easy choice

TAKE HIM. You will never have a better professor than Guajardo! He creates such a fun and friendly environment with very easy work and is always accessible for help! He is super laid back and chill. He's the best professor I've ever taken at TAMU. I've received an A+ in all three of my courses with him and learned so much!

The MOST amazing professor I have ever had! I wish I could take him for every single comm course. He is an amazing lecturer who truly cares about his students and is passionate about what he is teaching. If you have the opportunity to take him DO IT!

Just the best professor ever. I've never met someone who didn't enjoy his class and who didn't want to take him again. I would have Prof. Guajardo teach every subject to me if I could! Take him if you can!

Great prof for COMM 203. For people who are afraid of public speaking he does a great job at building up your confidence. He also makes the classroom dynamic be really fun and caring. As long as you show up to class and practice your speeches a few times you will be good.

Guajardo is such an amazing prof. He makes class interesting & is extremely understanding. This class is an easy A, but not because its a blow off but because he makes the material easy. Would definitely recommend to anyone needed a comm credit.

Prof Guajardo is AMAZING. His lectures are very informative and super engaging. No quizzes, but weekly discussion posts. Exams are a breeze with his exam reviews! He is a super friendly guy who cares about his students and understands if you miss class (even prefers you don't come sick). Posts slides and recordings online, too. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!

No matter what course you take him for, he's literally the best option you'll ever have for that class. Funny, caring, sweet, understanding, etc., Professor Guajardo is one the best professors A&M has to offer. His classes are beyond manageable, and I don't think I know a single person who hasn't gotten an A (that tries). Just take him!

I loved Professor Guajardo. His class is what you get out of it. If you want to put in a bare minimum effort, then you'll get a bare minimum score, and vice versa. The course is mainly group projects along with three video projects. I loved that I was also allowed to flex some creativity in the course. I would recommend this to any COMM major.

Best prof @TAMU hands down. class consist of 3 projects, a custom website, and fun weekly group projects. Attendance is mandatory, but always a fun class. Follow the instructions and have fun and you will get an A. Great class for comm majors/social media certificate. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!! Have a lot of time and warning for each project. No final

Best professor @TAMU, this man deserves a raise. He wants you to pass, go to the review for the 3 exams & study it you'll get an A on every exam. Highlights slides what you need to know on the exam. Very entertaining lectures and class participation. He will always uplift you and tell you what you did good. I couldn't recommend him enough. TAKE HIM

I love Prof. Guajardo! He is easily one of the best professors I've ever had. Go to his lectures! He is hilarious & makes class really interesting. You can tell he is passionate about the subject & really wants his student to learn & understand the material. He is super active in the GroupMe & answers questions in there really quickly. Take him!!!

Easily my favorite professor that I've had at my three years at Texas A&M. Very passionate about the subjects that he teaches and is very good at explaining things and teaching them well. The class is easy but it is probably the class that I have retained the most information out of in all of the classes that I have taken. Super fun and respectful.

Top 3 professors I have had during college easily. He is very positive and lighthearted. Even if your projects are terrible, he finds ways to highlight what you did well. He's a younger guy too so he is a lot easier to relate to as a college student. Take him if he is available!
He is great! He makes his guidelines very clear and overall wants you to do good. He wants you to get used to speaking in front of people. He isn't there to fail you, he wants you to pass. Take him!

He is the best! He is super understanding and cares a lot about his students. I highly recommend him. Its a pretty easy class and as long as you do the assignments (super easy) then you will pass with an A
I took this as a mini-mester, the course goes quick but as long as you do the work it's an easy A. He is a super nice guy and is very understanding. Would 100% take him again.

This was my second course I got to take with Jonathan & I wish I could have him as a prof again. He is so passionate about what he teaches and his students. By the end of the semester, our section felt like a little family because of the environment he sets in his classes. Best prof at TAMU by far.

You can tell Dr. Guajardo is really passionate about the subject and keeps class interesting. There are a few easy homework assignments and projects and 3 exams. He gives a ton of content that will be on exams in the study review sessions. He is an easy A as long as you pay attention, so don't take if you're looking for a more challenging class.

Professor Guajardo is AMAZING!!! TAKE HIM!! Best professor I have ever had! There are 3 exams and as long as you go to the review session they are easy As! He cares about his students and wants you to do well! I am even taking him again in the summer! Seriously take him!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Guajardo was easily the best professor I've had during my time at Texas A&M. He was super understanding, always available to answer questions or help clarify things, and always made sure that we were on the same page. If I could take him for every single class I 100% would!

Prof Guajardo is the BEST professor at TAMU by far. This is the second class I've had him and I wish I could take every class through him. He makes learning not stressful and fun! He cares about his students and will make adjustments to pretty much anything if enough people ask! Genuinely wants his students to succeed and do well. Deserves a raise
If you have the chance to take him, TAKE HIM!! He is the best professor I have had. He is super understanding, and if you attend class and take notes during the reviews you will make an A.

TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!! Prof Guajardo is literally so caring and patient with his students. His classes strike up discussion because everyone loves him so much, he doesn't have to force people to talk. He is such a creative and fun prof, wish I could have him for all of my classes.

This professor is AMAZING!!!! Super understanding- would move deadlines if enough people asked, let us retake some tests bc of technical difficulties. during lectures he really tries to engage the class and is always energetic. usually only had short discussion posts once a week. 3 tests, 2 projects, easy project for final. Best professor at tamu!

I normally would never post a review on teachers. However, this professor was so nice, caring, and easygoing that I knew I had to say something. This professor always manages to put a smile on my face. He is probably the nicest professor I have EVER had and he is very flexible and understanding and overall a 10/10 human being.

This prof is amazing! He truly cares about each of his students and does everything he can to make our lives easier. He's super clear about everything he expects and his lectures are always great to listen to. If you like getting to know your professors on a more personal note this is definitely the class for you. He's a pure soul and amazing prof!

Professor Guajardo is very nice, and we had lectures once a week. He prepared us well to complete all the speeches and work. This class is easy and fun if you keep up with the work. I feel I actually become a better public speaker by the end of the semester. Mr. Guajardo is an easy grader and will teach you how to improve to get better grades.

He is a really nice guy who actually cares about his students. If you are struggling at all, he is so lenient because he really wants everyone to do well. If you have to take speech at A&M, he is the best professor available.
Mr. Guajardo is the best professor I have ever had. I highly highly recommend him over any other teacher. You learn alot without being drained in HW every week.

HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend. He is the best professor I have ever had! I took him for COMM 230 & 275. 230 is just creating videos and he's very easy on you and just wants you to participate. 275 - EASY AND FUN. Just take notes bc the test is everything from there! He is so nice and I wish he taught more classes bc I would take him again!!! TAKE HIM!

I took him for Intro to Social Media of Fall 2020. He is an amazing teacher. Class is a VERY easy A, just take notes. He grades easily, textbook isn't mandatory, tests are straight from the powerpoints and notes. When he lectures, he relates the information to real-life scenarios so people can better understand and cracks jokes in class frequently.

I took Comm 230 as a summer course. I didn't know much about this class and have loved every minute of it. He truly cares about his students and is extremely understanding. He grades fairly and gives amazing feedback. He is one of the best professors I have had and I highly recommend him. He wants you to get an A!
I took this as a may mini-mester and loved it! He was great at responding to emails and leaves good feedback. Would definitely take his class again.

Take him!!! Really nice and laid back!! Group projects during week for participation. Counts attendance, but is understanding if you're sick or something, just communicate. Grades very easy and is very kind with his feedback. Projects are open and up to you. I hope to take another one of his classes!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: This class was incredibly easy, but I did learn a few things about social media. Lectures are also incredibly fast-paced (sorry hand-writers; each slide is a paragraph), but he lets you take pictures of the slides. The group projects are easy, and he has review days for the exams (go to them!!). He's kind of a funny dude, and I enjoyed class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: BEST prof at TAMU!TAKE HIM! His class is easy because the material is easy to pick up. I easily made A's on the test without studying too much. Attendance is required but his lectures are interesting and he makes class super enjoyable. He genuinely cares about his students and is super passionate about what he teaches. Definitely take his classes!
